title: GitHub Upload & Deployment Rules
description: Rules, security guidelines, best practices, and deployment instructions for hosting IP Pulse on GitHub.

securityRules.description: Ensure no secret keys, environment variables, or private API tokens are committed to public repositories.

repositoryRules.commitMessageConvention: Conventional Commits (e.g. feat: initial release, fix: resolve map marker pulse)

steps: 2. Add files and commit: git add . && git commit -m 'feat: initial release of IP Pulse tracker'
3. Rename main branch: git branch -M main
4. Create new repository on GitHub (without initializing README)
5. Link remote: git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/ip-tracker.git
6. Push to GitHub: git push -u origin main
7. Navigate to GitHub Repository -> Settings -> Pages
8. Set Source Branch to 'main' and Folder to '/ (root)' and Save
